-- REQ: LANG-841 LANG-842 SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @name NVARCHAR(50) = N'world', @count INT = 0; BEGIN TRY SELECT TOP 10 [p].[Name], COUNT(*) AS [Total] FROM dbo.[People] AS p WHERE p.Created > DATEADD(day, -7, GETDATE()) AND p.Id <> @count GROUP BY p.[Name]; EXEC dbo.Greet @name = @name, @times = 2; PRINT 'Done: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SCOPE_IDENTITY()); END TRY BEGIN CATCH THROW 50000, 'Failed', 1; END CATCH GO
